'''Tulkh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was employed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Tulkh was one of the many bounty hunters who was hired to hunt down and find the [[Murakami orchid]]. He was the one to deliver the genuine orchid to [[Darth Scabrous]]. After delivery of the orchid Darth Scabrous used it as the last ingredient to a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]]. Tulkh was able to avoid contracting the virus from the Sith students, but minutes before escaping he was infected by the virus, via an infected [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun's]] spit. He was jettisoned into space and died as a result.
